refnamediv.refpurpose: Interface for services providing component definitions to systemd-sysupdate

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.SysUpdate.Provider is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

Services implementing this interface provide component definitions to systemd-sysupdate8. The tool connects to every socket bound in /run/systemd/sysupdate/provider/ and merges the components they describe with those defined in the file system: file system definitions take precedence, and among providers claiming the same component the one whose socket name sorts first wins. No specifier expansion is applied to the strings a provider returns. ListTargets() enumerates the components a provider knows about, DescribeTarget() reports the resources of one of them, where ResourceType distinguishes URL files and tarballs, local tarballs and GPT partitions; Transfer() transfers one of them. TargetIdentifier, TargetClass, Target, TransferSource, TransferTarget, Transfer, ManifestFormat, Feature, PathRelativeTo, ComponentSuccessAction and ComponentFailureAction describe what to fetch from where and how to proceed afterwards. Unknown targets are reported as NoSuchTarget. The interface is experimental.

refsect1.title: Security
refsect1.para: Provider sockets are collected from /run/systemd/sysupdate/provider/, which only the superuser may create entries in, and systemd-sysupdate runs as the superuser. The protocol performs no further authentication, so a provider that can bind a socket there is trusted as much as the component definitions in the file system it extends.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# Interface implemented by services that provide component definitions to systemd-sysupdate(8). systemd-sysupdate connects to all sockets bound in /run/systemd/sysupdate/provider/ and merges the components they provide with those defined in the file system. Components defined in the file system take precedence; among providers claiming the same component the one whose socket name sorts first wins. Unlike in the configuration files no specifier expansion is applied to any of the strings returned by a provider. # [Experimental] interface io.systemd.SysUpdate.Provider
# Class of a target. type TargetClass( # Container or machine managed by systemd-machined.service(8). machine, # Portable service. portable, # System extension managed by systemd-sysext.service(8). sysext, # Configuration extension managed by systemd-confext.service(8). confext, # Host system. host, # Component managed by systemd-sysupdate.service(8). component )
# Action to take after a component has been updated successfully. type ComponentSuccessAction( # Continue with the next component continue, # Finish the current update iteration, and start the next one restart )
# Action to take if updating a component failed. type ComponentFailureAction( # Continue with the next component, but fail at the very end continue, # Fail immediately fail )
# The type of a source or target resource of a transfer. type ResourceType( # A file downloaded from a URL, see Type=url-file in sysupdate.d(5). url_file, # A tarball downloaded from a URL, see Type=url-tar in sysupdate.d(5). url_tar, # A local tarball, see Type=tar in sysupdate.d(5). tar, # A partition in a GPT partition table, see Type=partition in sysupdate.d(5). partition, # A regular file, see Type=regular-file in sysupdate.d(5). regular_file, # A directory, see Type=directory in sysupdate.d(5). directory, # A btrfs subvolume, see Type=subvolume in sysupdate.d(5). subvolume )
# What a resource path is relative to. type PathRelativeTo( # The path is relative to the root directory, see PathRelativeTo=root in sysupdate.d(5). root, # The path is relative to the EFI System Partition, see PathRelativeTo=esp in sysupdate.d(5). esp, # The path is relative to the Extended Boot Loader partition, see PathRelativeTo=xbootldr in sysupdate.d(5). xbootldr, # The path is relative to $BOOT as defined by the Boot Loader Specification, see PathRelativeTo=boot in sysupdate.d(5). boot, # The path is relative to the directory specified with --transfer-source= on the systemd-sysupdate command line, see PathRelativeTo=explicit in sysupdate.d(5). explicit )
# The format of a manifest file listing the source files of a transfer. type ManifestFormat( # A SHA256SUMS file, see ManifestFormat=sha256sums in sysupdate.d(5). sha256sums, # A UAPI.16 manifest, see ManifestFormat=uapi16 in sysupdate.d(5). uapi16 )
# Identifier of a target. type TargetIdentifier( # Where the target was enumerated. class: TargetClass, # Name of the target, unique within a class. name: ?string )
# A target, i.e. a component offered by the provider along with its metadata, mirroring sysupdate.components(5). type Target( # Identifier for the target. id: TargetIdentifier, # The currently installed version of the target, if any. currentVersion: ?string, # All locally-known versions of the target. allVersions: ?[]string, # Whether the current version is installed but pending a reboot to become active. Always set when returned by ListTargets(). Not set by component providers, since this is a property of the local installation. currentVersionIsPending: ?bool, # URLs to zero or more AppStream catalog XML files describing the target. appStream: ?[]string, # The following fields carry the metadata of targets of class 'component', mirroring the settings of sysupdate.components(5). They are unset for targets of other classes. A short human readable description of the component. description: ?string, # URLs to documentation for the component. documentation: ?[]string, # Whether the component is enabled. When returned by ListTargets() this is the effective state and always set for components. If unset, the component is enabled. enabled: ?bool, # What to do after the component has been updated successfully, see SuccessAction= in sysupdate.components(5). successAction: ?ComponentSuccessAction, # What to do if updating the component failed, see FailureAction= in sysupdate.components(5). failureAction: ?ComponentFailureAction, # Whether the component is suggested for enablement. When returned by ListTargets() this is the evaluated state and always set for components. If unset, the component is not suggested. suggested: ?bool, # The minimum version to permit for all transfers of the component, see MinVersion= in sysupdate.components(5). minVersion: ?string, # The maximum version to permit for all transfers of the component, see MaxVersion= in sysupdate.components(5). maxVersion: ?string, # Versions to protect from removal for all transfers of the component, see ProtectVersion= in sysupdate.components(5). protectVersion: ?[]string )
# An optional feature, mirroring sysupdate.features(5). type Feature( # Identifier of the feature. Corresponds to the file name of a sysupdate.features(5) file, without the .feature suffix. id: string, # A short human readable description of the feature, see Description= in sysupdate.features(5). description: ?string, # URLs to documentation about the feature, see Documentation= in sysupdate.features(5). documentation: ?[]string, # URLs to AppStream catalog XML files describing the feature, see AppStream= in sysupdate.features(5). Currently at most one URL is supported. appStream: ?[]string, # Whether the feature is enabled, see Enabled= in sysupdate.features(5). If unset, the feature is disabled. enabled: ?bool, # Whether the feature is suggested for enablement, see Suggest= in sysupdate.features(5). If unset, the feature is not suggested. suggested: ?bool )
# The source of a transfer, mirroring the [Source] section of sysupdate.d(5). type TransferSource( # The resource type of the source, see Type= in the [Source] section of sysupdate.d(5). type: ResourceType, # The path or URL of the source, see Path= in the [Source] section of sysupdate.d(5). Unlike in the configuration file no specifier expansion is applied. path: string, # What the path is relative to, see PathRelativeTo= in the [Source] section of sysupdate.d(5). If unset, the path is relative to the root directory. pathRelativeTo: ?PathRelativeTo, # Patterns to match the source against, see MatchPattern= in the [Source] section of sysupdate.d(5). No specifier expansion is applied. matchPattern: []string, # The format of the manifest file listing the available source files, see ManifestFormat= in the [Source] section of sysupdate.d(5). If unset, defaults to 'sha256sums'. manifestFormat: ?ManifestFormat, # The URL of the manifest file, see ManifestPath= in the [Source] section of sysupdate.d(5). If unset, the manifest is acquired from the source URL, under the file name appropriate for the manifest format. No specifier expansion is applied. manifestPath: ?string, # Whether to match the user.uapi.match_* extended attributes of instances against the local system, see MatchXAttr= in the [Source] section of sysupdate.d(5). If unset, defaults to true. matchXAttr: ?bool )
# The target of a transfer, mirroring the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). type TransferTarget( # The resource type of the target, see Type= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). If unset, it is derived from the source type. type: ?ResourceType, # The path of the target, see Path= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). No specifier expansion is applied. path: string, # What the path is relative to, see PathRelativeTo= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). If unset, the path is relative to the root directory. pathRelativeTo: ?PathRelativeTo, # Patterns to match the target against, see MatchPattern= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). If unset, the source patterns are used. No specifier expansion is applied. matchPattern: ?[]string, # The GPT partition type to match, see MatchPartitionType= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). matchPartitionType: ?string, # The partition UUID to use for newly created partitions, see PartitionUUID= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). partitionUUID: ?string, # The partition flags to use for newly created partitions, see PartitionFlags= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). partitionFlags: ?int, # Whether to set the NoAuto partition flag, see PartitionNoAuto= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). partitionNoAuto: ?bool, # Whether to set the GrowFileSystem partition flag, see PartitionGrowFileSystem= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). partitionGrowFileSystem: ?bool, # Whether to zero out the remainder of the target partition after writing the payload, see PartitionZeroFill= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). If unset, defaults to on for Verity signature partitions and off otherwise. partitionZeroFill: ?bool, # Whether to mark the target read-only, see ReadOnly= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). readOnly: ?bool, # The UNIX file access mode to use for the target, see Mode= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). mode: ?int, # The boot counting tries left, see TriesLeft= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). triesLeft: ?int, # The boot counting tries done, see TriesDone= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). triesDone: ?int, # The maximum number of instances to keep, see InstancesMax= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). instancesMax: ?int, # Whether to remove temporary files from previous runs, see RemoveTemporary= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). removeTemporary: ?bool, # The path of a symlink to maintain pointing to the newest instance, see CurrentSymlink= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). No specifier expansion is applied. currentSymlink: ?string, # Whether to match the user.uapi.match_* extended attributes of instances against the local system, see MatchXAttr= in the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). If unset, defaults to false. matchXAttr: ?bool )
# A transfer, mirroring a sysupdate.d(5) transfer file. type Transfer( # Identifier of the transfer. Corresponds to the file name of a sysupdate.d(5) transfer file, without the .transfer suffix. id: string, # The minimum version to permit, see MinVersion= in the [Transfer] section of sysupdate.d(5). No specifier expansion is applied. minVersion: ?string, # The maximum version to permit, see MaxVersion= in the [Transfer] section of sysupdate.d(5). No specifier expansion is applied. maxVersion: ?string, # Versions to protect from removal, see ProtectVersion= in the [Transfer] section of sysupdate.d(5). No specifier expansion is applied. protectVersion: ?[]string, # Whether to cryptographically verify downloads, see Verify= in the [Transfer] section of sysupdate.d(5). If unset, verification is enabled. verify: ?bool, # URLs to changelogs, see ChangeLog= in the [Transfer] section of sysupdate.d(5). No specifier expansion is applied. changeLog: ?[]string, # URLs to AppStream catalog XML files, see AppStream= in the [Transfer] section of sysupdate.d(5). No specifier expansion is applied. appStream: ?[]string, # Identifiers of the optional features the transfer belongs to, see Features= in the [Transfer] section of sysupdate.d(5). features: ?[]string, # Identifiers of the optional features the transfer requires, see RequisiteFeatures= in the [Transfer] section of sysupdate.d(5). requisiteFeatures: ?[]string, # The source of the transfer, see the [Source] section of sysupdate.d(5). source: TransferSource, # The target of the transfer, see the [Target] section of sysupdate.d(5). target: TransferTarget )
# Lists the components this provider offers, as targets. method ListTargets() -> ( # The components this provider offers, as targets of class 'component', in the same format as returned by ListTargets() of the io.systemd.SysUpdate interface. Targets of other classes are ignored. Metadata fields left unset take their documented defaults. targets: []Target )
# Returns the full definition of one target: the target object with its metadata, and for components their features and transfers. method DescribeTarget( # The identifier of the target to describe. Currently only targets of class 'component' are supported. id: TargetIdentifier ) -> ( # The target object, carrying the component's metadata, as also returned by ListTargets(). target: Target, # The optional features of the component, equivalent to the *.feature files of a component defined in the file system. features: []Feature, # The transfers of the component, equivalent to the *.transfer files of a component defined in the file system. transfers: []Transfer )
# The provider does not offer the specified target. error NoSuchTarget()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.SysUpdate.Provider shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.SysUpdate.Provider.ListTargets '{}' invokes its ListTargets() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.SysUpdate.Provider interface was added in version 263.

ComponentFailureAction, ComponentSuccessAction, DescribeTarget(), Feature, ListTargets(), ManifestFormat, NoSuchTarget, PathRelativeTo, ResourceType, Target, TargetClass, TargetIdentifier, Transfer, TransferSource, and TransferTarget were added in version 263.
